title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The ICSP programme will be implemented in 18 communities located on the banks of the River Gambia. The programme will support 12,000 households (120,000 beneficiaries). Activities will include the reforestation and restoration of degraded mangrove forests (486 hectares of mangrove forests will be restored), supporting communities to develop Natural Resource Management Plans and developing bye-laws for sustainable oyster production at local level. Awareness raising activities will be conducted to increase understanding of threats to mangrove forests and of practices that contribute to their preservation. The programme will work with women oyster collectors in the 18 communities: delivering training on sustainable oyster production, establishing oyster rack cultures and providing equipment for oyster collection. Sheds for oyster processing will be established, stoves provided for oyster processing and training delivered on improved oyster extraction, processing and packaging. The programme will also support the establishment of vegetable gardens in the 18 communities. Inputs and training will be provided on vegetable production and horticulture. Communities will be supported to plant fast growing trees as an alternative source of fuel and to reduce pressure on mangrove forests. The programme will train and support selected community members to set up enterprises for the collection and reprocessing/recycling of waste. Additional green enterprises supported will include use of energy efficient cookstoves and alternative sources of fuel (solar, woodlots). A project in the Gambia building community adaptive capacity. Marked 2 for Adaptation.
